minutes.headline: Committee settled on a phased hybrid plan (Ritter, Town Hall, then TC Passios) and will meet the select board on the 16th.
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee used the hybrid concept to plug in rough square footage and a per-square-foot cost to get a ceiling estimate. Members debated Town Hall's ADA access and lot-line encroachment, whether to show numbers to the public at all, and how to phase the work. They agreed to return to the select board for guidance. The only formal vote was adjournment.

what_happened.line: The committee reached informal consensus on phasing: Ritter building first, Town Hall second, TC Passios third.
No formal vote was taken except adjournment; the committee agreed to return to the select board to finalize the hybrid concept and seek guidance.
A rough square-footage and per-foot cost method produced a ceiling estimate for three buildings, and members debated whether to show numbers to the public at all.
Members agreed any cost figures shown will be heavily qualified as notional and for comparison only.
A joint meeting with the select board is planned for Tuesday the 16th, with the chair to confirm the time.

why_it_matters: The phase order and the rough cost ceiling shape which town buildings are proposed first, and any resulting project would eventually come to residents as a funding vote at town meeting.
The estimates are notional, built from an earlier renovation's per-foot cost, so residents should treat them as a comparison tool rather than a price.
